# lean-pkg coverage

coverage.yaml (coverage/1): the paper-to-Lean map (or a library's main results) `page` renders.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg coverage [--json] [COMMAND]
```

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg coverage check`](coverage-check.md): validate coverage.yaml against claims.yaml and the receipts at HEAD; exit 0/1; read-only (--file without NAME: offline, no registry)

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).
